x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a CI not discovered for the staleness window, When the CMDB Data Manager policy runs, Then an attestation or retirement task is created for its owner Given duplicates by identifier exist, When de-duplication runs, Then remediation tasks are created and closed within the agreed cadence
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Stale and duplicate CIs are detected and remediated through governed tasks
